$comment: A server certificate nobody vouches for, pinned by its SHA-256. Shared by tests/shared/certificate.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest: the fingerprint is written down once and compared on both devices, so both must spell and compare it the same way.
$format: What a fingerprint looks like once tidied: hex pairs, colons, upper case.

format.name: bare lower-case hex, as a digest comes out
already colon-separated is left as it is
spaces and mixed case from a copy-paste
prose keeps only the letters that happen to be hex, which is why it is checked by eye

$same: Whether two spellings name the same certificate.

same.name: two empties are not a match
